forcedChoices.choice: orden (feminine) for an order of beings
forcedChoices.reason: Spanish forces a gender; the feminine is the usual one for a class or order of beings and matches the glossary form 'orden secundaria'.
Keeps the form of the quoted phrase 'threescore years and ten' without an archaic word; the sentence before gives the value of seventy.
'passing greatness' can mean transient or already fading; 'pasajera' keeps the transient sense and does not decide that it was already past. Low confidence.
'juicio final' carries the religious sense of the Last Judgment, which the English does not intend here.
Spanish 'espiritualismo' is mainly a philosophical term; 'espiritismo' is the word for the seance practice that the English names.
'su tradición' could also read as 'their tradition'; 'de ustedes' keeps the address to the reader.
The capital of 'Him' has no place in a Spanish clitic pronoun; the referent stays clear from the context.
